affected_mixed_studies.decision: Frequency-dependent pulsating results and acceleration-rate-dependent transient results must remain distinct. The fastest ramps have transition-like behaviour; slower ramps do not. Adding the aggregate unknown-scope row does not establish a new quantity-only pair.
affected_mixed_studies.current_use: methodological example only; no revised pair numerator claimed

affected_mixed_studies.decision: Internal wall-model error with the exact-for-mean closure and total error with practical closures are different comparison conditions.
